sql.commissionManagement.findActiveMilestone: SELECT id, milestone_type, display_order FROM brs.milestone_type where active is true
sql.commissionManagement.findAvailableMilest: with t1 as (SELECT id FROM brs.milestone_type where active is true except select milestone_id from brs.commission_plan_allocation where commission_plan_id = :planId) select mt.* from brs.milestone_type mt inner join t1 on t1.id = mt.id where mt.position_id = 1
select mt.* from brs.milestone_type mt where mt.position_id = 4
sql.commissionManagement.getUserPayrolls: select p.id, period_end, description, (select ( (select coalesce(sum(amount),0) as total from brs.project_commission_ledger where ledger_type_id = 1 and closer_id = :userId and payroll_id = p.id) + (select coalesce(sum(paid_to_date),0) as total from brs.project_commission_ledger where ledger_type_id = 3 and closer_id = :userId and payroll_id = p.id)) as total) as current_pay from brs.payroll p inner join flow.project p on id = any(p.selected_project_ids) inner join brs.project_commission_snapshot dcs on dcs.payroll_id = p.id left join brs.project_override_commission_snapshot docs on docs.project_commission_snapshot_id = dcs.id where (dcs.sales_rep_id = :userId or docs.user_id = :userId) and period_end >= '2019-01-01' group by p.id,period_end,description
sql.commissionManagement.customerSearch:
with override_totals as( select p.id,docs.user_id from brs.payroll p inner join brs.project_commission_snapshot dcs on p.id = dcs.payroll_id inner join flow.project d on dcs.project_id = d.id inner join brs.project_override_commission_snapshot docs on docs.project_commission_snapshot_id = dcs.id WHERE (docs.user_id = :userId) AND replace(lower(dcs.customer_name),' ', '') LIKE '%' || :searchQuery || '%' group by p.id,docs.user_id), commission_totals as( select p.id, d.closer_user_id from brs.payroll p inner join brs.project_commission_snapshot dcs on p.id = dcs.payroll_id inner join flow.project d on dcs.project_id = d.id where lower(dcs.customer_name) LIKE '%' || :searchQuery || '%' and d.closer_user_id = :userId group by p.id, d.closer_user_id ) select p.id, p.period_end, p.description, (with override_totals as( select p.id, docs.user_id,sum(docs.total) as override_total from brs.payroll p inner join brs.project_commission_snapshot dcs on p.id = dcs.payroll_id inner join flow.project d on dcs.project_id = d.id inner join brs.project_override_commission_snapshot docs on docs.project_commission_snapshot_id = dcs.id WHERE (docs.user_id = :userId) group by p.id,docs.user_id), commission_totals as( select p.id, d.closer_user_id,coalesce(sum(dcs.commissions_earned),0) - coalesce(sum(commission_paid_to_date),0) + coalesce(sum(commission_adjustment),0) as commission_total from brs.payroll p inner join brs.project_commission_snapshot dcs on p.id = dcs.payroll_id inner join flow.project d on dcs.project_id = d.id where d.closer_user_id = :userId group by p.id,d.closer_user_id)
select coalesce(commission_total,0) + coalesce(ot.override_total,0) as current_pay from brs.payroll p inner join brs.project_commission_snapshot dcs on p.id = dcs.payroll_id left join brs.project_override_commission_snapshot docs on docs.project_commission_snapshot_id = dcs.id left join override_totals ot on ot.id = p.id left join commission_totals ct on ct.id = p.id WHERE ((ot.user_id = :userId) or (ct.closer_user_id = :userId)) group by p.id,p.period_end, p.description,ot.override_total,commission_total ORDER BY p.period_end ) as current_pay from brs.payroll p inner join brs.project_commission_snapshot dcs on p.id = dcs.payroll_id left join commission_totals ct on ct.id = p.id left join override_totals ot on ot.id = p.id where((ot.user_id = :userId) or (ct.closer_user_id = :userId)) group by p.id,p.period_end, p.description ORDER BY p.period_end
sql.commissionManagement.getUserCommissions: SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM ( SELECT d.customer_name, d.system_size, cp.name as commission_plan, src.source_name as source, stg.stage_name as stage, (cp.total * d.system_size - coalesce(cpv.source_cost, cpv_m2.source_cost, 0)) as project_total_value, sum(dcl.amount) as paid_to_date, case when bool_or(d.cancelled_date is not null) then 0::numeric else ((cp.total * d.system_size - coalesce(cpv.source_cost, cpv_m2.source_cost, 0)) -- total value... - sum(dcl.amount)) -- ... minus paid to date end AS remaining_value FROM flow.project d LEFT JOIN brs.project_commission_ledger dcl on dcl.project_id = d.id and ledger_type_id = 1 LEFT JOIN brs.source src on d.source_id = src.id LEFT JOIN brs.stage stg on d.current_stage_id = stg.id LEFT JOIN brs.commission_plan_vw cpv on d.id = cpv.project_id AND cpv.milestone_id = 1 LEFT JOIN brs.commission_plan_vw cpv_m2 on d.id = cpv_m2.project_id AND cpv_m2.milestone_id = 2 LEFT JOIN brs.commission_plan cp on cp.id = cpv.commission_plan_id WHERE d.closer_user_id = :userId and installation_agreement_signed_date is not null AND (d.exclude_commission is null or d.exclude_commission is false) GROUP BY d.customer_name, d.system_size, src.source_name, stg.stage_name, cp.total, cp.name, cpv.source_cost, cpv_m2.source_cost UNION select p.customer_name, p.system_size, null as commission_plan, source.source_name as source, stg.stage_name as stage, null as project_total_value, null as paid_to_date, 0 as remaining_value from flow.project p left join brs.commission_plan_vw commission_plan_vw on p.id = commission_plan_vw.project_id left join brs.stage stg on p.current_stage_id = stg.id join brs.source on p.source_id = source.id where p.closer_user_id = :userId and (p.exclude_commission is null or p.exclude_commission is false) and installation_agreement_signed_date is not null and commission_plan_vw.project_id is null order by customer_name) AS sub_rows
sql.commissionManagement.getUserOverrides:
SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM ( SELECT d.id, d.customer_name, u.first_name||' '||u.last_name as closer_name, d.system_size, src.source_name as source, stg.stage_name as stage, opv.name as override_plan, (opru.allocation * d.system_size) AS override_total_value, sum(paid_to_date) AS paid_to_date, case when d.cancelled_date is not null then 0::numeric else ((opru.allocation * d.system_size) - sum(paid_to_date)) end AS remaining_value
FROM brs.project_commission_ledger dcl INNER JOIN flow.project d on d.id = dcl.projectl_id inner join flow.user u on u.id = d.closer_user_id LEFT JOIN brs.source src on d.source_id = src.id LEFT JOIN brs.stage stg on d.current_stage_id = stg.id LEFT JOIN brs.override_plan_vw opv on d.id = opv.project_id AND opv.milestone_id = 1 LEFT JOIN brs.override_plan_receiving_user opru on opv.override_plan_id = opru.override_plan_id AND opru.user_id = :userId
WHERE ledger_type_id = 3 AND (d.exclude_commission is null or d.exclude_commission is false) AND closer_id = :userId GROUP BY d.id, d.customer_name, d.system_size, source_name, stage_name, opru.allocation, opv.name,closer_name) AS sub_rows
sql.commissionManagement.getCommissionPlans: select cp.id, cp.name, cp.total, cp.status_id, cps.status_type, cp.description, count(cpu.id) filter (where (cpu.end_date is null OR cpu.end_date > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND cpu.start_date < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) as active_users from brs.commission_plan cp left join brs.commission_plan_user cpu on cp.id = cpu.commission_plan_id inner join brs.commission_plan_status cps on cp.status_id = cps.id WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name != '' and cp.position_id = :positionId group by cp.id, cp.name, cps.status_type order by cp.name;
sql.commissionManagement.getClosers:
SELECT u.id AS id, u.id AS userId, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name, ust.id AS userStatusTypeId, cp.name AS commissionPlan, cp.description AS commissionDescription, cp.id AS commissionPlanId, op.name AS overridePlan, op.description AS overrideDescription, op.id AS overridePlanId, coalesce(( select case when up2.id is null then null else true end as closer_active from flow.user_position up2 inner join flow.position p on up2.position_id = p.id where up2.user_id = u.id and p.company_id = 3 and up2.primary_flag IS TRUE AND up2.end_date IS NULL AND up2.archived IS NOT TRUE and up2.id in (select up5.id from flow.user_position up5 inner join flow.position p2 on up5.position_id = p2.id inner join flow.custom_field cf on up5.position_id = any(cf.system_list_option_ids) and cf.parent_custom_field_id = 9959 where up5.primary_flag is true and up5.archived is false and p2.company_id = 3 and cf.archived is false) AND ust.has_access is true),false) AS "is_active_user", (SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM (SELECT op2.name AS "receivingPlan", op2.description AS "receivingDescription", op2.id AS "receivingPlanId"
FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opru INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op2 ON opru.override_plan_id = op2.id and op2.position_id = 1 WHERE opru.user_id = u.id AND op2.status_id = 2) AS sub_rows) AS "receivingPlans" FROM flow.user u INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON up.user_id = u.id AND ((up.primary_flag IS TRUE AND up.end_date IS NULL AND up.archived IS NOT TRUE) OR 1 = 1) AND up.id IN (select up5.id from flow.user_position up5 inner join flow.custom_field cf on up5.position_id = any(cf.system_list_option_ids) and cf.parent_custom_field_id = 9959 where up5.primary_flag is true and up5.archived is false and cf.archived is false) inner join flow.company_user_status cus on cus.user_id = u.id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = cus.user_status_type_id and ust.has_access is true and ust.company_id = 3 LEFT JOIN brs.commission_plan_user cpu ON cpu.user_id = u.id AND (cpu.start_date <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (cpu.end_date >= current_timestamp OR cpu.end_date IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN brs.commission_plan cp ON cp.id = cpu.commission_plan_id and cp.position_id = 1 LEFT JOIN brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau ON opau.user_id = u.id AND (opau.start_date <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (opau.end_date >= current_timestamp OR opau.end_date IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN brs.override_plan op ON opau.override_plan_id = op.id and op.position_id = 1
GROUP BY u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, ust.id, cp.name, cp.description, cp.id, op.name, op.description, op.id ORDER BY name
sql.commissionManagement.getSetters:
SELECT u.id AS id, u.id AS userId, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name, ust.id AS userStatusTypeId, cp.name AS commissionPlan, cp.description AS commissionDescription, cp.id AS commissionPlanId, op.name AS overridePlan, op.description AS overrideDescription, op.id AS overridePlanId, coalesce(( select case when up2.id is null then null else true end as closer_active from flow.user_position up2 inner join flow.position p on up2.position_id = p.id where up2.user_id = u.id and p.company_id = 3 and up2.primary_flag IS TRUE AND up2.end_date IS NULL AND up2.archived IS NOT TRUE and up2.id in (select up5.id from flow.user_position up5 inner join flow.position p2 on up5.position_id = p2.id where up5.primary_flag is true and up5.archived is false and p2.id in (select unnest(string_to_array(value, ',')::int[]) from flow.company_configuration_value where code = 'SETTER_POSITION_IDS') and p2.company_id = 3) AND ust.has_access is true),false) AS "is_active_user", (SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM (SELECT op2.name AS "receivingPlan", op2.description AS "receivingDescription", op2.id AS "receivingPlanId"
FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opru INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op2 ON opru.override_plan_id = op2.id and op2.position_id = 4 WHERE opru.user_id = u.id AND op2.status_id = 2) AS sub_rows) AS "receivingPlans" FROM flow.user u INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON up.user_id = u.id AND ((up.primary_flag IS TRUE AND up.end_date IS NULL AND up.archived IS NOT TRUE) OR 1 = 1) AND up.position_id IN (select unnest(string_to_array(value, ',')::int[]) from flow.company_configuration_value where code = 'SETTER_POSITION_IDS') inner join flow.company_user_status cus on cus.user_id = u.id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = cus.user_status_type_id and ust.has_access is true and ust.company_id = 3 LEFT JOIN brs.commission_plan_user cpu ON cpu.user_id = u.id AND (cpu.start_date <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (cpu.end_date >= current_timestamp OR cpu.end_date IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN brs.commission_plan cp ON cp.id = cpu.commission_plan_id and cp.position_id = 4 LEFT JOIN brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau ON opau.user_id = u.id AND (opau.start_date <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (opau.end_date >= current_timestamp OR opau.end_date IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN brs.override_plan op ON opau.override_plan_id = op.id and op.position_id = 4
GROUP BY u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, ust.id, cp.name, cp.description, cp.id, op.name, op.description, op.id ORDER BY name
sql.commissionManagement.getPlans: SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(rows))) FROM (SELECT cpu.id as "userPlanId", cpu.start_date AS "startDate", cpu.end_date AS "endDate", cpu.note, cp.name , cp.id , cp.description FROM brs.commission_plan_user cpu INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan cp ON cp.id = cpu.commission_plan_id WHERE cpu.user_id = :userId order by cpu.start_date desc ) as rows
sql.commissionManagement.getOverrides: SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(rows))) FROM (SELECT opau.id, opau.user_id AS "userId", opau.start_date AS "startDate", opau.end_date AS "endDate", opau.note, op.id as "planId", op.name as "planName", op.description AS "planDescription" FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op ON op.id = opau.override_plan_id WHERE opau.user_id = :userId order by opau.start_date desc ) as rows
sql.commissionManagement.getCloserDetails: SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM (SELECT upv.user_id AS "userId", concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) AS name, upv.start_date as "positionStartDate", upv.position, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(plans))) FROM ( SELECT cpu.id as "userPlanId", cpu.start_date AS "startDate", cpu.end_date AS "endDate", cpu.note, cp.name , cp.id , cp.description FROM brs.commission_plan_user cpu INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan cp ON cp.id = cpu.commission_plan_id WHERE cpu.user_id = upv.user_id order by cpu.start_date desc) plans), '[]') AS plans, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(overrides))) FROM (SELECT opau.id, opau.user_id AS "userId", opau.start_date AS "startDate", opau.end_date AS "endDate", opau.note, op.id as "planId", op.name as "planName", op.description AS "planDescription" FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op ON op.id = opau.override_plan_id WHERE opau.user_id = upv.user_id order by opau.start_date desc) overrides), '[]') AS overrides, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(receiving))) FROM (SELECT op.name, opru.note, op.id, op.description, opru.m1_allocation as "m1Allocation", opru.m2_allocation as "m2Allocation" FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opru INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op ON op.id = opru.override_plan_id WHERE opru.user_id = upv.user_id AND op.name IS NOT NULL AND op.name != '') receiving), '[]') AS receiving FROM flow.user_positions_vw upv WHERE upv.user_id = :userId and upv.company_id = 3 limit 1) AS sub_rows
sql.commissionManagement.getCommissionPlanDe:
SELECT row_to_json(sub_rows) sub_rows FROM (SELECT cp.id, cps.status_type as "statusType", cp.name, cp.total, cp.description, cp.status_id as "statusId", concat(cu.first_name, ' ', cu.last_name) AS "createdName", concat(au.first_name, ' ', au.last_name) AS "approvedName", cp.created_by as "createdBy", cp.position_id as "positionId", cp.approved AS "approvedDate", coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(mt))) FROM ( select cpa.id as "commissionPlanAllocationId", cpa.milestone_id as "milestoneId", cpa.allocation, cpa.min, cpa.max, mt.milestone_type as "milestoneType" from brs.commission_plan_allocation cpa inner join brs.milestone_type mt on mt.id = milestone_id where cpa.commission_plan_id = cp.id order by mt.display_order, cpa.min, cpa.max ) AS mt), '[]') AS milestones, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sources))) FROM (SELECT cpsa.id, lov.name as "sourceName", mt.milestone_type as "milestoneType", ft.fee_type as "feeType", cpsa.fee_amount as "feeAmount", cpsa.source_id as "sourceId", cpsa.milestone_id as "milestoneId", fee_type_id as "feeTypeId" FROM brs.commission_plan_source_allocation cpsa INNER JOIN brs.milestone_type mt ON mt.id = cpsa.milestone_id INNER JOIN brs.fee_type ft ON ft.id = cpsa.fee_type_id INNER JOIN flow.list_of_value lov on lov.id = cpsa.source_id WHERE cpsa.commission_plan_id = cp.id order by lov.name ) AS sources), '[]') AS sources, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(users))) FROM (SELECT cpu.id, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name,
string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') FILTER (WHERE CASE WHEN cp.position_id = 1 THEN up.id IN (select up5.id from flow.user_position up5 inner join flow.custom_field cf on up5.position_id = any(cf.system_list_option_ids) and cf.parent_custom_field_id = 9959 where up5.primary_flag is true and up5.archived is false and cf.archived is false) WHEN cp.position_id = 4 THEN up.position_id IN (select unnest(string_to_array(value, ',')::int[]) from flow.company_configuration_value where code = 'SETTER_POSITION_IDS') END ) AS position, u.id AS "userId", cpu.start_date AS "startDate", cpu.end_date AS "endDate", false as "archived", (select cfv.text_value from flow.user_custom_field_value cfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id where cfga.custom_field_id = 454 and cfga.archived is false and cfv.user_id = cpu.user_id ) as "employeeId" FROM brs.commission_plan_user cpu INNER JOIN flow.user u ON cpu.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON up.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.position p ON p.id = up.position_id WHERE cpu.commission_plan_id = cp.id GROUP BY cpu.id, u.id) AS users), '[]') AS users FROM brs.commission_plan cp INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan_status cps ON cp.status_id = cps.id LEFT JOIN flow.user cu ON cp.created_by = cu.id LEFT JOIN flow.user au ON cp.approved_by = au.id WHERE cp.id = :planId) sub_rows;
sql.commissionManagement.getCommissionPlanUs: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(users))), '[]') FROM (SELECT cpu.id, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name, u.id AS "userId", cpu.start_date AS "startDate", cpu.end_date AS "endDate", string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') FILTER (WHERE CASE WHEN cp.position_id = 1 THEN up.id IN (select up5.id from flow.user_position up5 inner join flow.custom_field cf on up5.position_id = any(cf.system_list_option_ids) and cf.parent_custom_field_id = 9959 where up5.primary_flag is true and up5.archived is false and cf.archived is false) WHEN cp.position_id = 4 THEN up.position_id IN (select unnest(string_to_array(value, ',')::int[]) from flow.company_configuration_value where code = 'SETTER_POSITION_IDS') END ) AS position, (select cfv.text_value from flow.user_custom_field_value cfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id where cfga.custom_field_id = 454 and cfga.archived is false and cfv.user_id = cpu.user_id ) as "employeeId" FROM brs.commission_plan_user cpu INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan cp ON cpu.commission_plan_id = cp.id INNER JOIN flow.user u ON cpu.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON up.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.position p ON p.id = up.position_id WHERE cp.id = :planId GROUP BY cpu.id, u.id) AS users
sql.commissionManagement.getAvailableSources: with t1 as (select lov.id from flow.list_of_value lov where lov.parent_id = 5 and lov.archived is not true except select source_id from brs.commission_plan_source_allocation where commission_plan_id = :planId) select lov.id, lov.name as source_name from flow.list_of_value lov inner join t1 on t1.id = lov.id where lov.parent_id = 5 and lov.archived is not true order by lov.name
sql.commissionPlan.updatePlanUser: UPDATE brs.commission_plan_user SET note = :note, end_date = :endDate, date_modified = now() WHERE commission_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId
sql.commissionPlan.appendNote: UPDATE brs.commission_plan_user SET note = CONCAT_WS('; ', note, :note), date_modified = now() WHERE commission_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId AND start_date = :startDate AND end_date IS NULL
sql.commissionPlan.appendNoteToPlan: UPDATE brs.commission_plan SET notes = CONCAT_WS('; ', notes, :note) WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.editAssignedNote: UPDATE brs.override_plan_assigned_user SET note = :note, date_modified = now() WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId
sql.overridePlan.appendAssignedNote: UPDATE brs.override_plan_assigned_user SET note = CONCAT_WS('; ', note, :note), date_modified = now() WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId AND start_date = :startDate AND end_date IS NULL
sql.overridePlan.editReceivingNote: UPDATE brs.override_plan_receiving_user SET note = :note, date_modified = now() WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId
sql.commissionManagement.getSources: select lov.id, lov.name as source_name from flow.list_of_value lov where lov.parent_id = 5 and lov.archived is not true order by lov.name
sql.commissionManagement.getSource: SELECT cpsa.id, lov.name as "sourceName", mt.milestone_type as "milestoneType", ft.fee_type as "feeType", cpsa.fee_amount as "feeAmount", cpsa.source_id as "sourceId", cpsa.milestone_id as "milestoneId", fee_type_id as "feeTypeId" FROM brs.commission_plan_source_allocation cpsa INNER JOIN brs.milestone_type mt ON mt.id = cpsa.milestone_id INNER JOIN brs.fee_type ft ON ft.id = cpsa.fee_type_id INNER JOIN flow.list_of_value lov on lov.id = cpsa.source_id WHERE cpsa.id = :id
sql.commissionManagement.saveSource: INSERT INTO brs.commission_plan_source_allocation (commission_plan_id, milestone_id, fee_amount, fee_type_id, source_id) VALUES (:planId, :milestoneId, :feeAmount, :feeTypeId, :sourceId)
sql.commissionManagement.insertUser: INSERT INTO brs.commission_plan_user (commission_plan_id, user_id, start_date, end_date) VALUES (:planId, :userId, :startDate, :endDate)
sql.commissionManagement.updateUser: UPDATE brs.commission_plan_user SET start_date = :startDate, end_date = :endDate, date_modified = now() WHERE id = :id
sql.commissionManagement.insertEndDate: WITH active_commission_plans AS (SELECT cpu.id, cp.id AS plan_id, cp.name AS plan_name, cpu.user_id, cpu.start_date, cpu.end_date FROM brs.commission_plan cp INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan_user cpu ON cp.id = cpu.commission_plan_id WHERE cp.status_id <> 3 AND cpu.end_date IS NULL AND cpu.start_date <= :startDate AND cpu.user_id = :userId) UPDATE brs.commission_plan_user cpu SET end_date = :startDate :: DATE - INTERVAL '1 day', date_modified = now() FROM active_commission_plans p WHERE cpu.id = p.id
sql.commissionManagement.getCommissionPlanAl: SELECT row_to_json(milestone) AS milestone FROM (select cpa.id as "commissionPlanAllocationId", cpa.milestone_id as "milestoneId", cpa.allocation, cpa.min, cpa.max, mt.milestone_type as "milestoneType" from brs.commission_plan_allocation cpa inner join brs.milestone_type mt on mt.id = milestone_id where cpa.id = :id ) milestone
sql.commissionManagement.saveMilestone: INSERT INTO brs.commission_plan_allocation (allocation, commission_plan_id, milestone_id, min, max) VALUES (:allocation, :planId, :milestoneTypeId, :min, :max)
sql.commissionManagement.updateMilestone: UPDATE brs.commission_plan_allocation SET allocation = :allocation, min = :min, max = :max WHERE id = :id
sql.commissionManagement.findUsers: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(results))), '[]') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name, u.email, (SELECT string_agg(distinct p1.position, ', ') FROM flow.user_position up1 INNER JOIN flow.position p1 ON p1.id = up1.position_id where up1.user_id = u.id AND CASE WHEN :positions = 'closers' THEN p1.id = any (select unnest(cf.system_list_option_ids) from flow.custom_field cf where cf.parent_custom_field_id = 9959 and cf.company_id = 3) WHEN :positions = 'setters' THEN p1.id IN (4, 5, 6) END) AS position FROM flow."user" u WHERE u.id IN (SELECT up.user_id FROM flow.user_position up INNER JOIN flow.position p ON p.id = up.position_id WHERE ( CASE WHEN :positions = 'closers' THEN p.id = any (select unnest(cf.system_list_option_ids) from flow.custom_field cf where cf.parent_custom_field_id = 9959 and cf.company_id = 3) WHEN :positions = 'setters' THEN p.id IN (4, 5, 6) END)) AND ( concat(lower(first_name), ' ', lower(last_name)) LIKE lower(:search) OR lower(last_name) LIKE lower(:search) OR lower(u.email) LIKE lower(:search) ) and ( case when :planId::int is not null then u.id not in ( select user_id from brs.commission_plan_user where commission_plan_id = :planId ) else 1 = 1 end ) ORDER BY name LIMIT 10) results
sql.commissionManagement.updateSource: UPDATE brs.commission_plan_source_allocation SET milestone_id = :milestoneId, fee_amount = :feeAmount, fee_type_id =:feeTypeId WHERE id = :id
sql.commissionPlan.getCommissionPlanUserHist: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(aup))), '[]') FROM (SELECT cpu.id as "userPlanId", cpu.start_date AS "startDate", cpu.end_date AS "endDate", cp.name , cps.status_type AS status, cp.status_id AS statusId, cp.id FROM brs.commission_plan_user cpu INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan cp ON cpu.commission_plan_id = cp.id INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan_status cps ON cp.status_id = cps.id WHERE cpu.user_id = :userId ORDER BY cpu.end_date DESC) aup;
sql.commissionPlan.deleteUser: DELETE FROM brs.commission_plan_user WHERE commission_plan_id = :planId AND id = :commissionPlanUserId;
sql.commissionPlan.create: INSERT INTO brs.commission_plan (name, description, total, position_id, created_by, created) VALUES (:name, :description, :total, :positionId, :userId, now()) RETURNING id
sql.commissionPlan.assignProject: insert into brs.project_commission(project_id, commission_plan_id, date_created) values (:projectId, :planId, now())
sql.commissionPlan.checkProjectAssignment: select id from brs.project_commission where project_id = :projectId
sql.commissionPlan.update: UPDATE brs.commission_plan SET name = :name, description = :description, total = :total WHERE id = :id RETURNING id
sql.commissionPlan.clone: SELECT clone_commission_plan AS id FROM brs.clone_commission_plan( :planId::int, :startDate::DATE, :users::int[], :createdBy::int)
sql.commissionPlan.approve: UPDATE brs.commission_plan SET approved = now(), approved_by = :approvedBy, status_id = :statusId WHERE id = :planId
sql.commissionPlan.inactivate: UPDATE brs.commission_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy, status_id = :statusId WHERE id = :planId
sql.commissions.getUserDatesAsCloser: select up.user_id, up.start_date::date, up.end_date::date from flow.user_position up inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id where up.id in (select up5.id from flow.user_position up5 inner join flow.custom_field cf on up5.position_id = any(cf.system_list_option_ids) and cf.parent_custom_field_id = 9959 where up5.primary_flag is true and up5.archived is false and cf.archived is false) and p.company_id = 3 and up.user_id in (:userIds);
